newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Golden West year net profit rises 15 pct.
newsitem.headline: Golden West year net profit rises 15 pct.

text.p: Precious metals refiner Golden West Refining Corp Ltd on Wednesday reported a 15 percent rise in net profit to A$1.18 million for the year to March 31, 1997.

Consolidated earnings before tax of A$3.48 million were four times higher than for the previous year, reflecting the August 1996 acquisition of U.S.-based Handy and Harman Refining Group, Golden West said.
Handy and Harman, purchased for US$9 million, contributed pre-tax earnings of A$3.2 million for the seven-and-a-half months since the purchase.
The profit after tax followed a A$1.17 million abnormal write-down for the rationalisation of activities.
Golden West managing director Michael Ryan said earnings from Handy and Harman were in line with forecasts.
The consolidated earnings did not include the results of Metal Refining Operation Pty Ltd, a Port Moresby-based refiner in which Golden West has a 45 percent interest.
Golden West was untraded by 3.10 p.m. (0510 GMT) after closing steady at A$0.87 on Tuesday.
